identity.description: Lark (Larksuite) is the international version of Feishu, a collaboration suite (messaging, docs, calendar, tasks, approvals, admin) run by ByteDance. Its developer platform is Lark Open Platform at open.larksuite.com; the Feishu equivalent is open.feishu.cn.
identity.identity_notes: open.larksuite.com/llms.txt is the Lark Developer index. The official MCP README calls the product Feishu/Lark. The docs describe the Larksuite overseas domain, so this is the Larksuite product.

auth.oauth_flows: user_access_token is obtained via the standard OAuth 2.0 browser web flow; tenant_access_token is used for app-identity calls.
auth.scopes_notes: The app must apply for API permissions (scopes), and a tenant administrator must approve them before API calls or event listening work. Data scope is further limited by app data permissions.

access.production_restrictions: Scopes need tenant administrator approval, and a published app version needs admin approval. Store (marketplace) apps can only be created by ISV-qualified users. A test company can be configured for development so permissions take effect without approval.

read_ops: List and get messages and group chats (IM)
Docx content, search, and wiki nodes
write_ops: Create and modify tasks, including members and reminders
Create, update, and delete Bitable records
Document content import and drive permissions
api.limitations: Permissions are gated by admin approval and data permissions. Rate limits and paid-plan requirements were not established. The official MCP server is in Beta.
